business_summary: Changzhou Evergreen Technology Co., Ltd. provides solutions for the interior and exterior ornamentation of rail transit vehicles and buildings in China and internationally. The company operates through two segments: Rail Transit Business and Building Decoration Business. The Rail Transit Business provides interior trim products for rail transit vehicles, including modular composite flooring, heated composite flooring, escape doors, seats, handrails, driver's cab interiors, as well as maintenance services, spare parts, and onboard passenger information systems. The Building Decoration Business offers interior and exterior building decoration materials, such as aluminum honeycomb panels, ultra-thin stone honeycomb panels, and stainless steel honeycomb panels for use in exterior wall, interior, furniture, and elevator decoration. The company also develops and supplies supporting materials and products for ships, cruise ships, and special vehicles, and equipment upgrades. The company also provides painting and Han culture painting modules; honeycomb, modular, electric heating, foam, glued, equipment compartment, and phenolic floors; and information displays, electrical cabinets, luggage cabinets, tea and dining tables, glass partitions, aisle handrails, washrooms, sleepers, private rooms, emergency escape doors, mid-roofs, side roofs, air outlet grills, side walls, door stand covers, windshields, armrests, wind tunnels, seats, waists, driver's cab partitions, front cover cabinets of driver's cab, driver's interiors, secondary skeletons, sliding doors, multifunctional and wall cabinets, bars, toilets or showers, new energy shelters, bathrooms, and shower rooms, side wall panels, cabin boards, and folding conference tables, as well as building decoration systems. Changzhou Evergreen Technology Co., Ltd. was founded in 2005 and is based in Changzhou, China.
business_summary_ko: Changzhou Evergreen Technology Co., Ltd.는 중국 및 국제적으로 철도 운송 차량 및 건물의 내부 및 외부 장식에 대한 솔루션을 제공합니다. 이 회사는 철도 운송 사업과 건물 장식 사업이라는 두 가지 부문으로 운영됩니다. 철도 사업부는 모듈형 복합 바닥재, 가열식 복합 바닥재, 탈출 도어, 좌석, 난간, 운전실 내부는 물론 유지 관리 서비스, 예비 부품, 탑승객 정보 시스템 등 철도 운송 차량용 인테리어 트림 제품을 제공합니다. 건축장식사업은 외벽, 인테리어, 가구, 엘리베이터 장식 등에 사용되는 알루미늄 허니컴 패널, 초박형 석재 허니컴 패널, 스테인레스 스틸 허니컴 패널 등 건축 내외장 자재를 공급하고 있습니다. 또한 이 회사는 선박, 유람선, 특수 차량 및 장비 업그레이드를 위한 지원 자재 및 제품을 개발 및 공급합니다. 이 회사는 또한 회화 및 한 문화 회화 모듈을 제공합니다. 벌집형, 모듈식, 전기 가열식, 폼, 접착식, 장비 칸막이 및 페놀 바닥재; 정보 디스플레이, 전기 캐비닛, 수하물
